sources.src/editors/PersonnelEditor.vue:
<template>
  <section>
    <schema-form ref="form" v-model="formApi" :rule="rule" :option="option" />
    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import { getStaticConfig } from "../services/config-service.js";

export default {
  name: "PersonnelRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  },
  data() {
    return {
      formApi: {},
      option: {},
      rule: [],
      pickerVisible: false,
      loadError: null,
    };
  },
  mounted() {
    if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();
  },
  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return getStaticConfig("personnel-form")
        .then((response) => {
          if (response.ok) this.applyConfig(response.data);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      const rules = config.rule.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {
          item.on = { search: () => this.openPicker() };
        }
        if (item.field === "parentCode") item.value = this.parentNode.code;
        if (item.field === "parentName") {
          item.value = this.parentNode.name;
          this.formApi.setValue({
            parentId: this.parentNode.id,
            parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
            parentName: this.parentNode.name,
          });
        }
      });
      this.rule = rules;
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>

public_inputs.task:
# Maintenance task

The remote static-configuration endpoint used by the Personnel relationship
editor has been retired. Replace that request with the existing local JSON
configuration and keep the editor's existing behavior unchanged.

Do not migrate the Structure relationship editor.

limitations: Applies when replacing an asynchronous configuration source with an immediately available local resource while downstream application still depends on an asynchronously supplied API.
The public sources do not define cancellation, component-destruction, timeout, or rejection behavior while readiness is pending; do not invent those semantics.
A syntax/build pass does not establish runtime readiness ordering, write counts, callback binding, or behavioral equivalence.

rules.body: When a remote configuration request is replaced by a synchronous local import, retain an asynchronous completion boundary if applying the configuration depends on an API supplied later by a component event.

Before applying configuration that performs an imperative write, wait until the required API member exists and is callable; if it is already callable, cross the readiness barrier immediately through the same promise boundary.
Make the readiness observer one-shot: remove it after it observes the callable API, then resume configuration application exactly once for that load invocation.

Resolve the loading operation only after configuration application completes, so callers do not observe completion before cloning, callback attachment, parent-value preparation, the imperative write, and final rule assignment.

Preserve the original lifecycle triggers, per-application cloning, callback instance binding, field initialization, imperative field write, picker behavior, and error-reporting boundary when changing only the configuration source.
Limit the migration to the editor whose endpoint was retired; leave sibling editors on their existing ownership and loading policy unless the task independently authorizes their migration.

Verify that the migrated editor no longer imports or invokes the retired remote service, imports the intended local JSON, does not call the imperative API before readiness, and retains its returned-promise completion boundary; also run the public syntax/build checks and confirm preservation-only files remain unchanged.

checkpoints: Verify PersonnelEditor no longer calls getStaticConfig("personnel-form") or the retired remote endpoint.
Verify configuration application does not call formApi.setValue before the emitted form API supplies that method.
Run the public JavaScript/Vue syntax or build checks described in VISIBLE_CHECKS.md after any Action.
Verify StructureEditor.vue and test/configuration files remain unchanged.
forbidden_effects: Do not migrate StructureRelationshipEditor to local JSON configuration.
Do not change SchemaForm behavior, either JSON configuration file, tests, or project configuration.
Do not issue a remote static-configuration request for the Personnel editor.
Do not remove or weaken Personnel editor error reporting without further normative evidence.
Do not apply Personnel configuration before the form API is ready when doing so would throw or lose the existing imperative field write.
lifecycle_identity: Personnel configuration loading is triggered on mount only when active is true.
A transition of active to a truthy value triggers Personnel configuration loading.
getPageConfig remains a completion-observable operation compatible with its current returned-promise boundary.
Each successful application uses newly cloned rule entries and a newly cloned option object.
The unitLookup search callback remains bound to the current Personnel editor instance through openPicker.

obligations.text: Replace only the Personnel editor's retired remote static-configuration request with the existing local src/config/personnel-form.json configuration.
Keep the Personnel editor's mount and active-watch loading triggers unchanged.
Preserve readiness ordering: configuration application that invokes formApi.setValue must wait until the SchemaForm input event has supplied a setValue function.

Preserve Personnel configuration transformation: clone rules and options, attach unitLookup.search to openPicker, initialize parentCode and parentName rule values from parentNode, and imperatively write parentId, parentCode, and parentName once per successful application.
Preserve picker behavior so the button and configured unitLookup search callback set pickerVisible to true.
Do not migrate or otherwise alter the Structure relationship editor.
After an Action, preserve public source syntax/build validity.

ordering_barriers: The local Personnel configuration may be available synchronously, but applyConfig must not cross the form-API readiness barrier before formApi.setValue exists.
Assigning the completed rules array remains after rule cloning, callback attachment, parent value preparation, and the imperative parent-field write performed during applyConfig.
The local replacement must retain a meaningful completion boundary for getPageConfig rather than making callers observe completion before configuration has actually been applied.
preservation: Personnel's rule shape and option remain those from personnel-form.json, including compact layout and the four existing fields.
parentCode and parentName rule values continue to reflect the current parentNode.
parentId, parentCode, and parentName continue to be written through the form API on successful application.
unitLookup search and the visible Choose unit button continue opening the picker.
loadError remains available for failures arising at preserved asynchronous/readiness boundaries.
scope: Business-code changes are limited to the Personnel relationship editor and any strictly necessary Personnel-local loading/readiness logic under /workspace.
The existing local configuration is src/config/personnel-form.json.
StructureEditor.vue, SchemaForm.vue, configuration JSON, tests, and project configuration are preservation-only.

    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import personnelFormConfig from "../config/personnel-form.json";

export default {
  name: "PersonnelRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },

  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return this.waitForFormApi()
        .then(() => {
          this.applyConfig(personnelFormConfig);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    waitForFormApi() {
      if (typeof this.formApi.setValue === "function") {
        return Promise.resolve();
      }

      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const unwatch = this.$watch("formApi.setValue", (setValue) => {
          if (typeof setValue === "function") {
            unwatch();
            resolve();
          }
        });
      });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      const rules = config.rule.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {

          this.formApi.setValue({
            parentId: this.parentNode.id,
            parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
            parentName: this.parentNode.name,
          });
        }
      });
      this.rule = rules;
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>
